scip-clang records no reference on an #include line and gives no occurrence the Import role, so its index is no imports oracle: import_resolution is an imports dump's (the build-flags preprocessor oracle at tier A, or clang-includes at tier B), and file edges stay the index's cross-file references (tier A)
disposition: partial: target L4, met L2 (L1 good, L2 excellent), re-measured 2026-10-01 over the cmake compile databases of fmtlib/fmt 12.2.0 (51 entries), nlohmann/json v3.12.0 (93 test entries, include/ measured) and, new, gabime/spdlog v1.17.0 (34 entries: the library, its example and its tests). L1 good (universal-ctags 6.2.1, tier B): sym_recall 0.9449 (fmt 0.9588, json 0.9388, spdlog 0.9131), sym_precision 0.968, kind_agreement 1, range_agreement 0.9921, signature_coverage 1; spdlog's export and inline decorator macros (class SPDLOG_API logger, SPDLOG_INLINE before an out-of-line definition, SPDLOG_NOEXCEPT after it) misparse the classes and definitions they decorate, and fmt and json alone read L1 excellent as before. L2 excellent against scip-clang 0.4.0 (tier A) with the build's own compiler (clang-calls, Apple clang 21.0.0, tier A, LB-F116): call_precision 0.9517 (3,682 of 3,869; was 0.3208) and call_recall 0.9268 (3,682 of 3,973; was 0.9274), every class counted and disclosed in the notes: 1,551 fathom pairs written only where the compiler has no callee before instantiation and 119 written only on lines the build discards are out of both counts; 1,952 calls the compiler resolves that the index does not reference and 128 constructor calls scored against the index's class reference are in the truth; 646 index references at a function's declaration are not; 509 gtest TEST definitions are named by what is written; 391 fathom definitions in code the index does not index are scored against the compiler alone. The dialect's own errors are fixed (LB-F117: functional casts to builtin types, noexcept/sizeof/decltype/assert as callees, the `template` disambiguator, keyword-named definitions). Remaining (O360): fathom-only 187 (104 the compiler records no call at: a lowercase macro such as putc_unlocked, or a call inside a type: decltype, noexcept, an array bound; 27 resolved calls attributed to another caller; 26 misparsed callers; 13 gtest bodies; 12 functional casts through a project typedef such as ullong(x); 5 other); oracle-only 291, led by spdlog's macro-broken definitions (calls attributed to the namespace) and member initializer lists (a base constructor the dialect does not capture, a field initializer scip-clang names as a method). L3 unmet: import_resolution 1 (258 of 258), file_edge_precision 1, file_edge_recall 0.0794 against .25 (O283). L4 unmet: def_mapping 0.1575, typed_recall 0.1566. Dispatch (ADR-048 amendment D1): lang-parity against the CGO cppextract.go on the same subjects and oracles reads every metric ahead (sym_recall +0.409, call_precision +0.425, call_recall +0.0976, signature_coverage +1) but range_agreement 0.9921 < 0.9923, the incumbent's over half as many matched definitions; the 45 range misses are the same macro misparses (FMT_TRY/FMT_CATCH, FMT_CONSTEXPR before a constructor, SPDLOG_INLINE), so the dialect is not dispatched and no ExtractorEpoch bump is due for C++. Trigger: a lexical pre-pass that neutralizes decorator and try/catch macros in the tags engine (lifts L1 to excellent with spdlog, closes the range gap and spdlog's recall), or the owner reading a range_agreement delta of -0.0002 over a different population as parity.
